Their 'frozen' value is the frozen split, which is NOT a cluster-level draw (it splits 36 of 67 Aegis and 7 of 11 WildGuardMix clusters), so a frozen_percentile here places a split this distribution cannot produce; the two levels use independent seeds, so their means differ by Monte Carlo noise of about sqrt(2) * sd_over_draws / sqrt(n_draws)
